activity: Initial quiet readiness; retain entry/before/after/terminal host observations. As in the accepted Cargo-parent protocol, background activity never selects or rejects instruction samples based on effect. No native elapsed claim.

budget.setup_profiles: One excluded cold-document profile per arm per host; no sample replacement.

cache_state: Only the registry parsed-document cache is cold. Per-arm target/shared state and registry sources are already warm. After the untimed before build, rename the cache out of the active home; verify absence before and population after the measured Cargo parent.
independence: Two dedicated VMs with distinct authenticated machine IDs and independently built source-only banks; no compiled uv state crossed arms or hosts.
masking: Commit both fixed eight-pair blocks before either result. Both full raw, cold-cache and restoration gates precede all 32 final/self/stderr joins; all metric joins precede either unpooled host decision.
metric: Final Callgrind Ir for the complete Cargo parent, all parent threads, trace-children=no; compiler/linker/build-script/test children excluded.
native_scope: No elapsed claim. R1's failed native A/A safeguard and absent candidate A/B remain explicit; any future Y native study needs a separately fixed design and authority.
privacy: Full instruction/call records retained. Only profile command and path fields are substituted; per-profile original/raw/gzip/stderr and unchanged-nonpath-stream hashes are recorded. Private environment, transport and raw host records are not published.

statistics.estimator: geometric mean of paired candidate/baseline counts
statistics.multiple_testing: Both independent fixed VM blocks must pass separately; no pooled or additive claim.
statistics.sign: two-sided exact sign test, ties excluded in p and disqualifying for the 8/8 gate

stop_rules.condition: A prerequisite, exact binary/context/output, trace, exit, completeness, integrity or restoration guard fails; any observation is missing
stop_rules.decision: Cohort invalid/unqualified. Preserve every record; restore and park owned states. Keep incomplete/invalid effects unread. No replacement, extension, alternate host or retry of measured work.

stop_rules.condition: Both complete raw/restoration gates pass, but either block has any tie/loss, sign p >= .01 or lower 99% reduction bound <= .01
stop_rules.decision: Valid negative for Y first-use Cargo-parent Ir; close without added samples, threshold changes or a pooled substitute.

stop_rules.condition: Both complete raw/restoration and metric gates pass and each block has 8/8 wins, p < .01 and lower 99% reduction bound > .01
stop_rules.decision: Qualifies only Y first-use Cargo-parent Ir after both independent raw/effect replays. No native elapsed or publication authority.

workload_edit: Use the exact accepted donor fixture: append a deterministic ordinary non-doc comment, warm its state=before form, then change it to state=after_. The strings have equal length and five changed bytes. All Rust tokens and source positions remain unchanged. Restore the original source afterward; no production uv change.
